intro.title: Build cron scheduler for periodic tasks
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple cron scheduler in Node.js to run periodic tasks automatically. You will learn how to use the built-in `node-cron` package to schedule functions at specific time intervals. The core programming concepts involved include importing npm packages, defining scheduled tasks, and handling time-based execution. By the end, you'll have a working script that logs messages to the console on a recurring schedule.
intro.usecase: Cron schedulers are a fundamental backend pattern for automating periodic tasks in real-world software. You'll find them in production systems that send daily email digests, generate nightly financial reports, or clean up temporary data from databases. As a developer, you might build a dashboard that triggers these scheduled jobs or configure a system to run health checks every few minutes to ensure service reliability.
